# open.mp / SA-MP development repositories

Generated by `tools/pawn/gen_omp_repos.py` from `repos.tsv`. Every row is a git submodule pinned to the commit shown
(nothing is downloaded by a normal clone). Fetch one: `git submodule update --init --depth 1 <folder>`.

## Web tools and docs

- [awesome open.mp](https://open.mp/docs/awesome) - community list of libraries
- [Pawn playground](https://pg.open.mp/) - compile Pawn in the browser
- [SA-MP model ids](https://dev.prineside.com/en/gtasa_samp_model_id/) - object / model id search
- [weather ids](https://dev.prineside.com/en/gtasa_weather_id/) - weather id preview
- [gang zone editor](https://dev.prineside.com/en/gtasa_gangzone_editor/) - draw gang zones on the map

Extra files in `research/Samp/`: `Grimrandomer-samp-zone-editor-*.zip`, `Map Editor.zip`, `SHA512.zip`, `Tp/`,
`YSI-Includes-nightly.zip`, `bmodshop.inc`, `nativechecker.zip`.
